name: Rio Ngumoha

career_stints.note: Academy career only, joined age 8, considered Chelsea's top prospect in his age group with reported first-team training exposure under Mauricio Pochettino -- but no senior Chelsea appearance before his July 2024 move to Liverpool (age 15). Transfer was contested; a tribunal set Liverpool's fee at an initial £2.8m, rising by up to £4m in add-ons.

First-team appearances since his senior debut (Jan 2025 FA Cup start vs Accrington Stanley, Liverpool's youngest-ever starter). 2025/26 Premier League split: 17 appearances, 952 minutes, 2 goals -- the most first-team minutes of any Premier League player aged 17 or under that season. His first PL goal was a 100th-minute winner at Newcastle on his top-flight debut (age 16 years 361 days), Liverpool's youngest-ever Premier League scorer. Won the Premier League Debutant of the Season and a Scholar of the Year award for 2025/26. Assists total not reliably verifiable, omitted rather than guessed.

notes: All per-90 advanced metrics left null: no reliable per-90 figures were found for his actual senior 2025/26 Liverpool sample. Scouting reports (Total Football Analysis, ScoutingStats) describe him qualitatively as a high-volume, high-completion dribbler and explosive 1v1 threat, and one source gives 12.91 dribbles/90 at 64% completion -- but that figure is explicitly from England U16 level, not his Liverpool senior sample, so it was not used here to avoid misrepresenting an U16 stat as a current playstyle metric.

career_stints[0].appearances is 0 by design (not a placeholder/guess) -- it records a true fact: he had zero senior Chelsea appearances despite six years in their academy. Included for transfer-chronology context per the project's convention of keeping career_stints honest even when sparse for young players.

position_estimate.basis is 'liverpool_recent_minutes' since 952 minutes clears the roughly-900-minute threshold used elsewhere in this project, though confidence is kept moderate (0.5) given he is still a 17-year-old with under a full season of senior football and only became a regular starter from January 2026 onward.
Sources: liverpoolfc.com, tribuna.com, si.com, aol.com, totalfootballanalysis.com, footystats.org (via search), thisisanfield.com, empireofthekop.com -- via web search 2026-08-10.
